title: Versioned generation is the default: ph generate emits v1/gen, v1/src and an upgrades/ folder, not a flat gen + src pair
content:
Versioning is **enabled by default**. Running `ph generate document-model --document TodoList.phd` with no extra flags produces a versioned tree, not the flat `gen/` + `src/` pair that older docs and tutorials describe.

The layout emitted in a live 6.2.2 project:

```
document-models/
├── document-models.ts        # exports every version of every model
├── upgrade-manifests.ts      # exports every model's upgrade manifest
└── <name>/
    ├── <name>.json           # the spec, at the model root
    ├── index.ts              # barrel → the latest version
    ├── upgrades/             # versions.ts, upgrade-manifest.ts, index.ts
    └── v1/
        ├── gen/              # auto-generated — never edit
        ├── src/reducers/     # yours to implement
        ├── tests/
        ├── schema.graphql
        ├── module.ts         # DocumentModelModule with version: 1
        ├── actions.ts, hooks.ts, utils.ts, index.ts
```

Two details the academy's sketch gets slightly wrong, verified against generated output: `document-models.ts` and `upgrade-manifests.ts` sit at the **project level** (`document-models/`), not inside each model folder; and `schema.graphql` lives inside `v1/` while `<name>.json` stays at the model root.

Why it matters: every deep import path now carries a version segment. A path like `document-models/todo/gen/creators.js` does not exist — it is `document-models/todo/v1/gen/<module>/creators.js`, and it moves when you cut v2. This is the concrete reason to import from the model's top-level barrel, which always points at the latest version, instead of reaching into `gen/`.

The `upgrades/` folder is generated even at v1, when there is nothing to upgrade from. It holds `versions.ts` (the supported-versions tuple) and `upgrade-manifest.ts`, ready for the first transition.

_Source: apps/academy/docs/academy/03-Build/02-DocumentModelCreation/04-UseTheDocumentModelGenerator.md, layout confirmed against generated output (Powerhouse v6.2.2-dev.45)._
description: Versioning is on by default, so output is document-models/<name>/v1/... plus upgrades/, with document-models.ts and upgrade-manifests.ts at the project level.
